game_version: not stated on the pages (poe2db.tw fetched 2026-11-17; RePoE poe2 export is 0.5.5.9 but has no master choice data)

Evolutionary Pressure.text:
1% increased Rarity of Items Dropped by Monsters per Explicit Modifier on the Map
2% increased Effectiveness of Monsters per Explicit Modifier on the Map
Rare Monsters have a 3% increased chance of Monster Modifiers per Explicit Modifier on the Map

Stitch the Flesh.text: Your Maps have an additional Revival, up to 6

Refined Formula.text: Monsters released from Essences become Corrupted

Improved Calibration.text: Waystones have 25% more effect of Prefix Modifiers or 25% more effect of Suffix Modifiers when opening Maps

Careful Procurement.text: Magic Monster Packs have 35% chance to have an additional Modifier

Mechanical Guardians.text:
Non-Unique Strongboxes are guarded by a dormant Construct
These Strongboxes only roll Modifiers which apply to the Construct
Opening the Strongbox activates the Construct
Strongboxes have 2% increased Item Quantity per Modifier

Hidden Patterns.text: 10% chance when completing a Map to make nearby Maps accessible

Volatile Connection.text: 15% chance areas are Cleansed or Corrupted

Head of the Snake.text:
Pinnacle Bosses have 25% chance to drop an additional Unique item
Powerful Map Bosses have 5% chance when defeated to reveal a nearby Citadel
Pinnacle Bosses have a single Revive

Dam the River.text: Azmeri Spirits only Possess monsters after reaching maximum empowerment

Remnants of Greatness.text:
Map Bosses have 20% chance to be guarding a Precursor Terraformer
which can be used to change the biome of a group of maps nearby

Breeding Season.text:
15% increased Rare Monsters
Rare Monsters have 25% increased chance of Monster Modifiers

Mighty Prey.text: 25% chance to upgrade Map Bosses to Powerful Map Bosses

Scarred Lands.text:
20% increased number of Rare Expedition Monsters
15% increased number of Runic Monster Markers

Soul Eaters.text: Map Bosses have 2% increased Effectiveness per 100 Power of Monsters slain in the Area

Dangerous Game.text: Rogue Exiles have 20% chance to Flee to an adjacent Map and upgrade their Equipment

Will of the Draíocht.text: Azmeri Spirits cannot Possess Rare Monsters

Lethal Adaptation.text: 40% increased Effectiveness of Unique Monsters with Modifiers

Call of the Spirits.text: Possessed Unique Monsters Release Spirits on death

Ancient Inscriptions.text: 8% increased effect of Explicit Modifiers on Tablets for each type of Tablet affecting Map area

Gutting and Skinning.text:
Pinnacle Bosses may be scavenged for 5% chance to drop an additional Unique item
1% chance Unique Monsters may be scavenged for a Unique item

Claimed Territories.text: Overlord's Influence and Overlord's Domain Atlas Passive Skills have 45% chance to add twice as much content

Patient Battue.text:
25% chance 1 Rare Monster is replaced by a random Map Boss
5% chance 3 additional Rare Monsters are replaced by a random Map Boss

Unexpected Missions.text:
Corrupted Waystones open a Random Map Area when used on Basic Maps
Corrupted Waystones open Maps with 1 additional random Modifiers

In the Wrong Hands.text: Powerful Map Bosses drop an additional unique item

Trove Seekers.text:
100% increased amount of Rare Chests
Strongboxes have 100% increased chance to be Unique

Mysterious Gifts.text:
Unique Monsters have 1% chance to drop a Cryptic Key
Rare Strongbox Monsters have 5% chance to drop a Cryptic Key

Eastern Knowledge.text: Verisium Remnants have 10% chance to be rolled an additional time, keeping the rarest outcome

Unforeseen Threats.text: 5% chance on completing Maps for a nearby Anomaly Map to be revealed

Partial Translations.text: Randomly gain between 0 and 40% increased effect of Explicit Modifiers on Tablets

Long Days.text: 20% more chance of Random Extra Content

Stolen Relics.text: Unique Strongboxes may be the Legacy of the Order, dropping a Twilight Reliquary Key

Ancient Activations.text: Powerful Map Bosses have 5% chance to add a Ancient Modifiers to a nearby Map

Untold Histories.text:
35% increased chance to find Lineage Supports
Pinnacle Bosses take 35% less Damage
Pinnacle Bosses have an 50% increased chance to drop Lineage Supports
